description: Defines the 'quantizer' class for floating point quantization to fixed point representation, including methods for conversion between float, brain float, complex float, and fixed point, with sign extension support.

classes.name: quantizer
classes.description: Handles quantization of floating point numbers to fixed point with specified bit width, supporting various conversions and sign extension.

methods.name: to_fixed_point
methods.description: Quantizes a float or brain float value into a 16-bit integer.

methods.name: to_float
methods.description: Converts a fixed point integer back to floating point.

methods.name: to_float (overload)
methods.description: Converts a sequence of fixed point values to complex floating point values.

methods.name: to_brain_float
methods.description: Converts a sequence of fixed point values to complex brain floating point values.

methods.name: sign_extend
methods.description: Performs sign extension on a 16-bit integer value.
